scripts.text:
[Wolf]
Are you here to join the protest? But you don't seem like an experienced protester.
scripts.translation:
[狼]
你是来参加抗议的吗？但你看起来并不像是有经验的抗议者。

scripts.text: - This quest is available from level 170 onward. -
scripts.translation: - 此任务需要等级170以上才能接取。 -

scripts.text:
[Ordinary Person]
This area is under maintenance and access is prohibited. It's dangerous. Please step back.
scripts.translation:
[普通人]
该区域正在维护中，禁止进入。那里很危险，请退后。

scripts.text:
[Ordinary Person]
This area is under maintenance and access is prohibited.
scripts.translation:
[普通人]
该区域正在维护中，禁止进入。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
You don't need to be cautious. This person is an adventurer who is with us.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
不用那么谨慎。这位是与我们同行的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Are we all gathered now?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
大家都集合好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Yeah, everyone's ready. We just need to signal our people scattered around and enter the temple.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
嗯，大家都准备好了。我们只需要向分散在各地的同伴发出信号，然后进入神殿。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
We need to move quickly.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我们需要快速行动。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
When we enter here, we can go towards the side entrance of the temple. We'll enter when we receive a response after sending the signal over there. Adventure, can you send the signal?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
进入这里后，我们可以前往神殿的侧门。等我们向那边发出信号并收到回应后，我们就进入。冒险者，你能发出信号吗？

scripts.text: We need to be prepared.
scripts.translation: 我们需要做好准备。

scripts.text: Beep-

[Suad]
Since we've sent the signal, the emergency passage will open soon. Let us know when you're ready. We'll enter immediately.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
既然信号已经发出，紧急通道很快就会打开。准备好后告诉我们，我们会立即进入。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
^ff0000An unknown error occurred.^000000
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
^ff0000发生未知错误。^000000

scripts.text:
[Suad]
We haven't sent the signal yet. Once everyone is ready, we'll send the signal immediately.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
我们还没有发出信号。等大家都准备好后，我们会立即发出信号。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
^ff0000Only a member of the party can enter the Memorial Dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
^ff0000只有队伍成员才能进入记忆地下城。^000000

scripts.text:
[Suad]
The signal has come, so let's move. Let's enter right away.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
信号已经收到，我们出发吧。立即进入。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Right. Adventurers are also essential forces, so let's wait until they're ready.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
没错。冒险者也是不可或缺的力量，所以我们要等他们准备好。

scripts.text:
[Ordinary Person]
Hello, adventurer. An agent from a temple has been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[普通人]
你好，冒险者。有一位来自神殿的特工一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Where's the party leader?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
队伍首领在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
It's not looking good right now. I think... The armed guards increasing their security..
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
现在情况不妙。我想...武装卫兵正在加强安保...

scripts.text: Looks like the issue with the riot on top is a big one.
scripts.translation: 看来上面的暴动是个大问题。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Or the information was leaked. Otherwise, we wouldn't have been prepared.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
或者是情报泄露了。否则，我们不会有所准备。

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
No further entry is permitted. Surrender to your arrest.
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
禁止继续前进。请投降受审。

scripts.text:
[Natives]
What have we done? We're not supposed to be in here!
scripts.translation:
[原住民]
我们做了什么？我们不该在这里！

scripts.text:
[Natives]
This is our land! If the owner wants to enter into their own land, why should anyone be stopping them?
scripts.translation:
[原住民]
这是我们的土地！如果主人想进入自己的领地，为什么有人要阻止他们？

scripts.text:
[Natives]
You're the ones who are illegally occupying it!
scripts.translation:
[原住民]
你们才是非法占据这里的人！

scripts.text:
[Natives]
What the hell, give it back!! Our land!!
scripts.translation:
[原住民]
该死的，还给我们！！我们的土地！！

scripts.text:
[Native Leader]
We are the longtime owners of this land and have been displaced from our homes by the settlers.
scripts.translation:
[原住民首领]
我们是这片土地长期的主人，却被定居者赶出了家园。

scripts.text:
[Native Leader]
We have come to claim our rightful place as the longtime inhabitants of this land.
scripts.translation:
[原住民首领]
我们回来是为了夺回我们作为这片土地长期居住者的正当权利。

scripts.text:
[Native Leader]
Our demands are as follows.
scripts.translation:
[原住民首领]
我们的要求如下。

scripts.text:
[Native Leader]
One! We have...
scripts.translation:
[原住民首领]
第一！我们...

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Suad, did you give any specific instructions to the people who were rioting at the top?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
苏阿德，你有没有给上面那些暴动的人下达具体指令？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
No? Why?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
没有？为什么？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
See those guys over there? They're moving cautiously. That's the group that did the attack on the top.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
看到那边那些人了吗？他们行动很谨慎。那就是袭击上面那群人。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
I didn't give you any instructions. Are you trying to act on your own?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
我没给你下过指令。你是想擅自行动吗？

scripts.text: Looks like they're heading for the temple.
scripts.translation: 看起来他们正朝神殿去。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
It's an action that's not discussed beforehand. I already have a history, and that's not a good thing, is it? I'm going to have to tread quietly, I don't know what else I'm going to do..
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
这是没有事先商量好的行动。我已经有前科了，这可不是好事，对吧？我不得不小心翼翼地行动，我不知道还能做什么...

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Are you going alone?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
你一个人去？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
I'm just following behind, why do I need a group? I'm good enough on my own. You stay here, I'll signal if anything happens.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我只是跟在后面，为什么需要团队？我一个人就够了。你留在这里，如果发生什么事我会发信号。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
They say that they're only following, but there's no telling what they might be doing. Even if they're unarmed, they might be hiding something...
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
他们说是只是跟着，但谁知道他们在做什么。即使他们没有武器，也可能藏着什么...

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Well, that's a relief. I can't make any hasty moves here. Miriam left a trace. Now do me a favor and just follow the trace.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
那就好。在这里不能轻举妄动。米莉亚姆留下了痕迹。请帮我个忙，顺着痕迹跟上去。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
小心。

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
This place is off-limits.
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
此处禁止入内。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
I'm Miriam, the daughter of High Priest Amal. We've been following a suspicious group of people into this area..
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我是米莉亚姆，神官阿马尔的女儿。我们一直在追踪一群可疑的人进入这个区域...

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
Are you here to help the High Priest with his work?
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
你是来协助神官工作的吗？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Work... help...? Is my father here?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
工作...协助...？我父亲在这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
Ah...
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
啊...

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
No one here is suspicious. You may leave now.
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
这里没有任何可疑的人。请离开。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Are you sure there aren't any suspicious people coming in? They've obviously gotten into this place, give me a second and I'll check it out quickly.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你确定没有可疑的人进来吗？他们显然已经进入了这里，给我一点时间，我会快速检查的。

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
If you get any closer, we will take action.
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
如果你再靠近，我们将采取行动。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
...Can't help it, then. Can you, Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
...没办法了。冒险者，你可以吗？

scripts.text: Yes. I'll handle it, you go after them.
scripts.translation: 可以。交给我，你去追他们。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Then do me a favor, I'll leave a trail so you can find me..
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
那就拜托了，我会留下痕迹让你找到我...

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
Intruder...! Argh!!!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
入侵者...！啊！！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Whoa! What the hell are you doing here, with an Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
哇！你在这里做什么，还带着一个冒险者？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
You shouldn't be here right now. If the Temple finds out, it will only make things more difficult for us.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你不应该在这里。如果神殿发现了，只会让事情变得更糟。

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Don't you see? We're breaking into a library. There must be a lot of secrets of the settlers in here.
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
你没看到吗？我们在闯入图书馆。这里一定有很多定居者的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
We can think about that later. For now. Go back. Your actions now could put us in more danger..
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我们可以之后再考虑。现在，回去。你现在的行动可能会让我们陷入更大的危险...

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Go home, Miriam. I'm not going to cooperate with your stuffy behavior anymore.
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
回家吧，米莉亚姆。我不再配合你那种死板的行为了。

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
There, intruder!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
那里，入侵者！

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
Everyone lay down your weapons and raise your hands!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
所有人放下武器，举起双手！

scripts.text: How do I do this?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
We're outnumbered, let's deal with it.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我们人数处于劣势，先处理一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Good timing. Then we'll say goodbye!
scripts.translation:
[坤]
时机正好。那么，再见了！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Hold on, Adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
等一下，冒险者！

scripts.text: Leave this one to me!
scripts.translation: 交给我吧！

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Did you find it? What kind of a place is this?
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
你找到了吗？这是什么地方？

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Not yet. I don't think it's on this side. Oh, wait... The High Priest's...?
scripts.translation:
[坤]
还没有。我觉得不在这边。哦，等等...神官的...？

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Leave the irrelevant books alone. That's not what we're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
别管那些无关的书了。那不是我们要找的。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
You guys...!
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你们...！

scripts.text: Shhh-hold on a second.
scripts.translation: 嘘...等一下。

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Even the most secretive of libraries wouldn't just leave a book like that lying around.
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
即使是再隐秘的图书馆，也不会把这样的书随便放在那里。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
So is there another secret library within the secret library?
scripts.translation:
[坤]
所以是在秘密图书馆里还有一个秘密图书馆吗？

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
I don't know. Let's just find it.
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
我不知道。我们找找看吧。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
It would be nice to know the book title.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
要是知道书名就好了。

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
If I knew that, I wouldn't be here. I'd be like, 'Bring me anything that looks like that.' Go find it.
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
我要是知道，就不会在这里了。我会直接说“把看起来像那样的书都拿来”。快去找到它。

scripts.text: Doesn't it look like they're looking for a specific book?
scripts.translation: 他们看起来像是在找特定的书？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
A specific book...? Not just a book to exploit weaknesses?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
特定的书...？不仅仅是用来利用弱点的书吗？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
No, you mean this? Hey! What are you looking for? For what purpose?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
不，你是指这个吗？嘿！你们在找什么？目的是什么？

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Oh, there you go again! Why are you eavesdropping? As if you have something shady to share.
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
哎呀，又来了！你们在偷听什么？搞得好像你们有什么见不得人的秘密要分享似的。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
You're the ones who sneaked in with the shady stuff, remember? What's the book you're looking for?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
明明是你们带着见不得人的东西偷偷溜进来的，别忘了？你们到底在找什么书？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
That really hurts, man. Don't you realize that we're trying to make a good thing out of this? Can't you understand that we're trying to make a better life for everyone?
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
这话真伤人啊。难道你没意识到我们在努力让事情变得更好吗？难道你不懂我们是在为所有人争取更好的生活吗？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
They'll never know how much we care. It's about time you showed up, by the way...
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
他们永远不会知道我们有多关心。话说回来...你终于出现了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
You have to catch them and make them open their mouths...!
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
必须抓住他们，逼他们开口...

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
Here we go! The intruder is here!!!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
来了！入侵者在这里！！！

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
Drop your weapon!!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
放下武器！！

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Isn't this the end of the line?
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
这下完蛋了吧？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
I know. They must have a real secret library.
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
我知道。他们一定有个真正的秘密图书馆。

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
I told you to find it in the first place, not just come to me because it's there.
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
我让你去找它，不是让你因为那里有就只来找我。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Ask if it's okay to back out.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
问问能不能退出。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Wait, am I seeing things? That's Miriam and the Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
等等，我没看错吧？那是米莉亚姆和冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Who are you guys talking to?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你们在跟谁说话？

scripts.text: Are you guys paid to do this?
scripts.translation: 你们是拿钱办事的吗？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Payment? We don't get that, do we?
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
报酬？我们好像没拿到吧？

scripts.text:
[??]
Is this the end of the library?
scripts.translation:
[??]
这里是图书馆的尽头吗？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Yes, it is.
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
是的，就是这里。

scripts.text:
[??]
I wish I could have found the book, but I can't. They've done their work, so we're out of here.
scripts.translation:
[??]
我真希望能找到那本书，但我找不到。他们已经完成了任务，我们撤了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Who are you? What do you have to do with these people?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你是谁？你和这些人有什么关系？

scripts.text:
[??]
What is it? Is there something else?
scripts.translation:
[??]
怎么了？还有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Someone sniffed out the wolf and decided to follow us. We'll take care of it soon.
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
有人嗅到了狼的气味，决定跟踪我们。我们很快就会处理掉它。

scripts.text:
[??]
That's not necessary. You guys should get out of here and let the new guys take over.
scripts.translation:
[??]
没必要。你们应该离开这里，让新人接手。

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Yes!!
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
是的！！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Wait!!!
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
等等！！！

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
Take care of all intruders!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
清除所有入侵者！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
It seems like a weird twist of fate, huh? The Temple Guards have been bought off. We need to find out what's going on...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
看来真是命运弄人，不是吗？神殿卫兵被收买了。我们需要弄清楚发生了什么...

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
All hands in formation!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
全体列队！

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Oh, no~ I'm sorry we've crossed paths, we got dirty, so let's not meet again?
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
哎呀~ 抱歉我们碰上了，我们身上脏兮兮的，所以别再见面了？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
What are you doing? How many people are there? I can't see much from here.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你在做什么？那里有多少人？从这里看不太清楚。

scripts.text: There are a few people I don't recognize.
scripts.translation: 有几个我不认识的人。

scripts.text:
[???]
How far are we from there?
scripts.translation:
[???]
我们离那里还有多远？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
We're almost there now.
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
我们快到了。

scripts.text:
[???]
It's really, really, really secure. I'm just saying.
scripts.translation:
[???]
那里真的、真的、真的非常严密。我只是说说而已。

scripts.text:
[???]
... Aren't you at least this secure?
scripts.translation:
[???]
...你们至少有这么严密吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
Hey, Mr. Genius, don't you know how to make an irony?! Tight security is not synonymous with cumbersome and demanding procedures, right?
scripts.translation:
[???]
嘿，天才先生，你不知道什么是讽刺吗？严密的安保并不等同于繁琐苛刻的程序，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
This voice is...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
这个声音是...

scripts.text: Do you know them?
scripts.translation: 你认识他们吗？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
It's obscured, so I'm not sure...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
声音有些模糊，我不确定...

scripts.text:
[???]
Enter.

[Miriam]
Let's go in too.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我们也进去吧。

scripts.text:
[???]
Schulang, have you secured it yet? This Bagot is about to lose patience.
scripts.translation:
[???]
舒朗，你搞定了吗？巴戈特快要失去耐心了。

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
But do we have to keep this on?
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
但我们必须一直戴着这个吗？

scripts.text:
[Schulang]
Who cares? You came this far. Do as you please.
scripts.translation:
[舒朗]
谁在乎？你都走到这一步了。随你便吧。

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Hah- now that's a life saver.
scripts.translation:
[约皮]
哈——这下可真是救星啊。

scripts.text: The Heart Hunters were undercover.
scripts.translation: 心之猎手是卧底。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Hearthunter... you're working with those mad scientists you were talking about... from the very beginning...!
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
心之猎手...你从一开始就在和那些你提到的疯狂科学家合作...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are still a lot of Heart Hunters remodeled with Ymir's heart left, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还有很多用伊米尔的心脏改造过的心之猎手，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Schulang]
Was it our old face? Ah, those are the small fries that are said to be tracking you. I heard the news.
scripts.translation:
[舒朗]
是我们以前的脸吗？啊，那些据说正在追踪你的小喽啰。我听到消息了。

scripts.text: That would be Illusion.
scripts.translation: 那就是<黑暗搜集者>幻觉。

scripts.text:
[Bagot]
Oh, my God, I don't want to embarrass you.
scripts.translation:
[巴戈特]
天哪，我不想让你难堪。

scripts.text:
[???]
You're all good to go.
scripts.translation:
[???]
你们都可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
...Father??
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
...神父？

scripts.text:
[Amal]
Miriam, You've come this far. You've done your part, now go home.
scripts.translation:
[阿马尔]
米莉亚姆，你已经走到这一步了。你尽到了你的责任，现在回家吧。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
What do you mean? What are you doing...?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你什么意思？你在做什么...？

scripts.text:
[Bagot]
Wow, you got praised by your dad. That's great. Compliments for good parenting, it's important.
I don't even remember getting my praise. Um... Ah! I don't remember because I never got it.!
scripts.translation:
[巴戈特]
哇，你被爸爸表扬了。真棒。表扬良好的教养，这很重要。
我甚至不记得自己受过表扬。嗯...啊！我想不起来，因为我从来没受过表扬！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
What, what's going on? Why did my dad... What did you do?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
什么，发生什么事了？为什么我爸爸...你对他做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Amal]
... Once you've got what you need, let's move on.
scripts.translation:
[阿马尔]
...一旦你拿到了你需要的东西，我们就继续前进。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Father! Father!!!
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
神父！神父！！！

scripts.text:
[Bagot]
A father who praises you but never loves you?
scripts.translation:
[巴戈特]
一个表扬你但从不爱你的父亲？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
What are you doing to my father?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你在对我父亲做什么？

scripts.text:
[Bagot]
Oh, you don't know, do you? His wish is to drive all the natives out of Arunafeltz. We helped a little with that, but not for free.
scripts.translation:
[巴戈特]
哦，你不知道吗？他的愿望是将所有原住民赶出阿鲁纳菲兹。我们帮了一点小忙，但可不是免费的。

scripts.text:
[Heart Hunter]
Miriam, you and your friends have helped me complete this picture of the riot. Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[心之猎手]
米莉亚姆，你和你的朋友们帮我完成了这幅暴乱的画卷。非常感谢！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Do you think that makes sense?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你觉得这说得通吗？

scripts.text:
[Bagot]
What are you talking about, a handful of impulsive protests to the temple?
scripts.translation:
[巴戈特]
你在说什么？对神殿的几次冲动抗议？

scripts.text:
[Bagot]
Soon the protest outside will turn into a riot, and then your wish will be granted, and then you'll make another wish, and then we'll get paid again?
scripts.translation:
[巴戈特]
很快，外面的抗议就会变成暴乱，然后你的愿望就会实现，接着你又会许下一个愿望，然后我们就能再次拿到报酬了？

scripts.text:
[Schulang]
I'm not going to talk forever. Let's go.
Clean up your mess.
scripts.translation:
[舒朗]
我不会一直说下去的。走吧。
收拾好你们的烂摊子。

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Four!
scripts.translation:
[拉马库斯]
四！

scripts.text:
[Heart Hunter]
I wish I had Suad here with me. I wish I could've helped him out sometime.
scripts.translation:
[心之猎手]
我真希望苏阿德能在这里陪着我。我真希望能有机会帮帮他。

scripts.text:
[Heart Hunter]
Hi, let me formally introduce ourselves. We're the Heart Hunters, and we're about to bury you here.
scripts.translation:
[心之猎手]
你好，让我正式介绍一下。我们是心之猎手，我们即将把你埋在这里。

scripts.text: Watch out, they're modified.
scripts.translation: 小心，它们被改造过了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
He's always been like that... Is there something ominous about that?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
他一直就是这样...这有什么不祥的预兆吗？

scripts.text: It seems to resonate with the heart of Ymir here.
scripts.translation: 它似乎与这里伊米尔的心产生了共鸣。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
That's basically a quick count, right? Okay, let's make it quick and get on with it.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
这基本上就是快速计数，对吧？好吧，让我们快点结束，继续前进。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Ha... Hah... Adventurer, are you all right?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
哈...哈哈...冒险者，你没事吧？

scripts.text: But where did they all go?
scripts.translation: 但他们都去哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
What, what's all the fuss about?
Adventurer...? Why are you here, Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
什么，发生什么事了？
冒险者...？你为什么在这里，冒险者？

scripts.text: Here's what...
scripts.translation: 是这样的...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
You've been tracking a colleague who's been acting suspiciously, and it turns out they're actually a mole.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
你一直在追踪一位行为可疑的同事，结果发现他其实是个内鬼。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
You're in the same league as my father.?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
你和我父亲是同一类人？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
High Priest?? What does that even mean?
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
神官？那是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
I think my father is involved in this.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我想我父亲也牵涉其中。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
How is that... High Priest...? We'll have to investigate.
I'm sure there are instigators lurking in the crowd outside, planted by the bad guys...
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
怎么会...神官...？我们必须去调查。
我确信外面的人群中潜伏着幕后黑手安插的煽动者...

scripts.text: It's also among the Temple Guard.
scripts.translation: 神殿卫兵中也有。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We're going to need to do a major overhaul...first we need to figure out what we've been doing here, making sure there's nothing dangerous, and nothing is lost... even among the Temple Guards.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我们需要进行一次大整顿...首先得弄清楚我们在这里做了什么，确保没有危险物品，也没有东西丢失...甚至包括神殿卫兵在内。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
...!!
No need to investigate, Ymir's heart shard is missing. It's supposed to be there.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
...！！
不用调查了，伊米尔的心之碎片不见了。它本该在那里。

scripts.text: I know...
scripts.translation: 我知道...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
What the heck they're going to do with it... I can't even imagine.
This is not what we should be doing, we need to tell the truth and track them down...!!
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
他们到底要拿它做什么...我简直无法想象。
这不是我们应该做的，我们需要说出真相并追踪他们...！！

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Ah...! You said there would be enemies among the Temple Guards, so we'll have to pick out the ones we trust first.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
啊...！你说神殿卫兵中有敌人，所以我们得先挑出我们信任的人。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
I'll go. That's probably my father's, because I have a pretty good idea of where it might have gone.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我去吧。那大概是我父亲的，因为我大致知道它可能去了哪里。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We'll talk about that when we get outside, because it's not looking good out there.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
等我们出去再说吧，因为外面的情况看起来不妙。

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
Acknowledge us!
scripts.translation:
[人群]
承认我们！

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
We're alive! We are here!!
scripts.translation:
[人群]
我们活着！我们在这里！！

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
This is Our Land!
scripts.translation:
[人群]
这是我们的土地！

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
Return the land to the rightful owners of the land!
scripts.translation:
[人群]
把土地归还给真正的土地所有者！

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
If you dismiss now, we will not charge you for trespassing on the temple!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
如果你们现在离开，我们就不会以擅闯神殿的罪名起诉你们！

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
I'll give you exactly 30 minutes! Go back within the time limit!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
我只给你们30分钟！在时限内回去！

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
Are you threatening us now?
scripts.translation:
[人群]
你们这是在威胁我们吗？

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
What are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[人群]
你们打算怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
You're going to arrest everyone and put them in jail, right?
scripts.translation:
[人群]
你们要把所有人都抓起来关进监狱，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
At this point, let's go in first!!!
scripts.translation:
[人群]
事已至此，让我们先进去！！！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Something's not right. People are getting too aggressive.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
情况不对劲。人们变得越来越具有攻击性了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
This doesn't look good. I need to get Suad, but where's the deputy?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
这看起来不妙。我需要去找苏阿德，但副手在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
There you are. I brought along Priest Zhed.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
你在这里。我带牧师泽德一起来了。

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
What's going on here? Does it have something to do with the people who have flocked here? Or, is there something inside the temple that's causing this...
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
这里发生什么事了？和那些聚集在这里的人有关吗？还是说，是神殿内部有什么东西导致了这一切...

scripts.text:
[Suad]
What's going on? You said it's something urgent.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
发生什么事了？你说情况很紧急。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Once you've got it covered, move fast. They're waiting for you at the safe house.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
一旦你处理完手头的事，动作要快。他们在安全屋等你。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
We have a mole among us.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我们内部有内鬼。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
A mole? Where?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
内鬼？在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Suad, first of all, give us an overview of the situation here. It sounds like we're on the verge of a riot, is that right? Oh, hello, Priest Zhed.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
苏阿德，首先，请给我们介绍一下这里的情况。听起来我们正处于暴动的边缘，对吗？哦，你好，牧师泽德。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Why is the High Priest here?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
神官怎么会在这里？

scripts.text:
[Zhed]
Miriam? Did Miriam have anything to do with this?
scripts.translation:
[泽德]
米莉亚姆？米莉亚姆和这件事有关吗？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
There's a reason for that, but first, let's talk about the situation, Suad?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
这其中有原因，但首先，让我们谈谈情况，苏阿德？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
It's not good. It's spiraling out of control. The temple is coming down hard on us. They're recommending we disband. We're running out of time. We're preparing to evacuate.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
情况不妙。局势正在失控。神殿对我们施压很大。他们建议我们解散。时间不多了。我们正在准备撤离。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
What happened to the people you followed?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
你跟踪的那些人怎么样了？

scripts.text: Let me explain.
scripts.translation: 让我解释一下。

scripts.text: - The events inside the temple. -
scripts.translation: - 神殿内部发生的事件。 -

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
My father and a foreign power conspired to divide Arunafeltz and oppress the natives...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
我的父亲与一股外国势力勾结，企图分裂阿鲁纳菲兹并压迫原住民...

scripts.text:
[Suad]
There's a mole among us... but who's the impostor?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
我们内部有内鬼...但谁是冒牌货？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
It's more accurate to say they're gone into hiding than traitorous. They were never on our side to begin with.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
更准确地说，他们是在隐匿，而不是背叛。他们从一开始就不在我们这一边。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
So we were almost in the middle of an organized riot from the start?
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
这么说，我们一开始就身处一场有组织的暴动之中？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
This is not the time. They've infiltrated the temple as well, so we have to take on both sides..
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
现在不是时候。他们也已经渗透进了神殿，我们必须同时应对这两方...

scripts.text:
[Suad]
What's that whistle? It's not our signal.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
那是什么哨声？不是我们的信号。

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
Why you're taking clothes off??
scripts.translation:
[人群]
你们为什么要脱衣服？

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
Keep your guard up!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
保持警惕！

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
What the hell are you doing??
scripts.translation:
[人群]
你们在干什么？

scripts.text:
[Crowd]
Argh!!!! Argh!!! The temple guard grabs a man!!!
scripts.translation:
[人群]
啊！！啊！！神殿卫兵抓住了一个男人！！

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard]
It's a riot! Put it down!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫兵]
是暴动！放下武器！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Oh... I'm late...!
scripts.translation:
[米莉亚姆]
啊...我迟到了...

scripts.text:
[Suad]
We need to stop the brute-force attackers.
scripts.translation:
[苏阿德]
我们需要阻止那些暴力袭击者。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I'll evacuate the people.
scripts.translation:
[尼伦]
我去疏散人群。

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard Captain]
Well done, everyone! The cleansing will continue daily! Let's disband for today and take a rest!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫队长]
大家做得很好！净化仪式将每天继续举行！今天到此结束，大家休息吧！

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard Captain]
Adventurer, thank you for your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫队长]
冒险者，感谢你的协助。

scripts.text:
[Temple Guard Captain]
I've heard that you'll also be joining us for a separate cleansing operation inside the temple. We'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[神殿卫队长]
我听说你也将参与在神殿内部进行的另一场净化行动。拜托你了！

scripts.text: Awaiting security code reset. Please input the new security code.
scripts.translation: 等待重置安全代码。请输入新的安全代码。

scripts.text: Cancel input
scripts.translation: 取消输入

scripts.text: Security code reset in progress. Please enter the new security code.
scripts.translation: 正在重置安全代码。请输入新的安全代码。

scripts.text: Cancel input
scripts.translation: 取消输入

scripts.text: Vault security code has been reset.
scripts.translation: 金库安全代码已重置。
